narrative.overview:
Ax Oficina rejects two ruts at once: the generic Tailwind-starter-kit look the product shipped with, and any theatrical "mechanic shop" costume (wrenches, caution-stripe yellow-and-black). What replaces both is the restraint of the best operational SaaS panels — a near-white/near-black neutral scale, a single confident accent reserved for action and real state, and typography carrying the entire hierarchy. The finish bar is explicitly Linear: full fidelity to that level of polish and calm, no ironic or "customized" flourish layered on top.

The system was built code-led (no comp), refined and finish-reviewed in this session: a calm hairline-and-soft-shadow elevation model, one authored entrance motion, tabular-numeral KPI typography, and — as of this review — color that communicates only real state, never decoration or position.
keyCharacteristics: Near-white/near-black neutral scale (slate ramp) carries almost everything; color is the exception, not the texture.
One accent (orange) is reserved for the primary action and genuinely active/open state — it does not decorate.
Hairline 1px borders do the primary separating; soft real shadows (never a colored halo) add elevation only where it means something.
Every KPI and table figure uses tabular numerals.
One authored entrance motion plays once per screen mount; nothing else moves on its own.

rules.name: The State-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Color communicates a real, present state — success, warning, danger, info, or the one reserved active/primary accent — and nothing else. An icon chip, an empty-state illustration, or a KPI tile never takes a saturated color because it looks good or fills a grid; it earns color only when it is actually reporting that state.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Operational Orange is spent on at most one primary action and one "active work" metric per view. When a hero row needs more than one saturated tile at once, the extra tiles must each be answering a real success/warning/danger question — never simultaneous decoration.

rules.name: The Tabular Numeral Rule
rules.body: Every KPI value, table figure, and currency amount is set with tabular-nums. A number that moves (refresh, live update) never reflows its neighbors.

rules.name: The Real Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow is always a genuine offset-plus-blur pair sampled from the neutral ink color, never a flat colored glow or a border-radius trick standing in for depth.

dos: Do reserve Operational Orange for the primary action and genuinely active/open state — nothing else earns it.
Do set every KPI, table figure, and currency amount in tabular numerals.
Do pair every shadow with a real offset + blur sampled from ink; define dark-mode shadows independently rather than scaling the light values.
Do keep icon chips to one small Lucide glyph on a flat tint — never an illustration or gradient.
Do place exactly one primary call-to-action per view, anchored top-right of the page header.
donts: Don't color an empty or neutral state success-green by default — reserve success for a genuinely positive outcome.
Don't assign a warning/danger/primary tone to a metric that isn't actually reporting that state.
Don't duplicate a primary call-to-action between the page header and the navigation chrome.
Don't ship two card panels presenting the same underlying list from different angles when one prioritized list says it clearly.
